short: Fractographical characterization of hot pressed and pressure
title: Fractographical characterization of hot pressed and pressureless sintered AlN-doped ZrB2-SiC composites

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Adding AlN as a sintering aid should promote densification of ZrB2-SiC composites. ZrB2-30 vol% SiC with phenolic resin binder that pyrolyses to ~1.6 wt% carbon sintering aid.
states.detail: Absorbed: h1 (HYP/hypothesis), d1 (DES/base_system), d2 (DES/modification), d3 (DES/variable_sweep), p0 (PRC/treatment), p1 (PRC/forming), p2 (PRC/forming)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: In AlN-doped HP composites a thin Al-, Si-, B-, C-, N-bearing amorphous layer lines ZrB2/SiC grain interfaces. HP composites with 1 and 5 wt% AlN reach ~100% relative density, above AlN-free HP (~97.5%).

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: AlN reduces surface B2O3 to BN + Al2O3; the Al2O3-SiO2-based liquid drives liquid-phase sintering during hot pressing. HP Vickers hardness peaks at ~20.3 GPa with 1 wt% AlN and falls slightly (~19.2-19.4 GPa) at 3-5 wt%.
states.detail: Absorbed: m1 (MEC/pathway), r1 (PRP/value), r2 (PRP/value). Premises: AlN reduces the B2O3 surface oxide of ZrB2 to BN and Al2O3 (Eq. 1) [22]

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: AlN aids densification and hardness of ZrB2-SiC only under hot pressing; pressureless, it lowers density and hardness

nodes.title: MICRO, F3, F4
nodes.head: PS0 fracture surface shows more and larger pores and fewer, smaller necks than HP0. PS1 fracture surface is an open skeleton of faceted grains with necks and larger pores than PS0
nodes.solves: PS composites stay porous and porosity grows with AlN (relative density ~85.5% at 0 to ~70% at 5 wt%)
nodes.note: HP0 (F3a): thick arrows mark remaining pores and coarsened grains, thin arrows mark mixed inter/intragranular fracture (marker meaning per linked text); PS0 (F3b): thick arrows mark necks and pull-out sites, with more dark cavities
nodes.necessity_reason: s3 keeps shown support from o2 after removal.

nodes.title: MICRO, F4, F5, F7
nodes.head: Fracture surface is dense, without open pores, with large flat transgranular facets. An extended layered interfacial phase (thick arrows) lies between grains on the fracture surface.
nodes.solves: HP composites with 1 and 5 wt% AlN reach ~100% relative density, above AlN-free HP (~97.5%)
nodes.note: facets up to ~10 um (5 um bar ~135 px); HP5 (F5a) shows the same transgranular surface; sample HP1 per caption sample HP5 per caption (packet F5 = paper Fig. 6) 100 nm bar ~91 px; caption names the grains ZrB2 and SiC and the sample HP5
